home.practice_deflectors_blurb: Build a grid of mirrors one piece at a time, then fire every emitter at once. Light targets through the lenses they ask for, and light several in one shot to multiply it.
deflectors.title: Deflectors
deflectors.how_to: A round deals a set number of pieces: mirrors, and now and then a lens. The queue under the grid shows the next few, and the count beside it says how many are left. Tap a cell to put the next piece there, over whatever is there already, or tap the bin to throw it away. Tap the next piece to turn a mirror before it goes down. Nothing comes on a timer: take the time a choice needs, but the round's clock keeps running. Three emitters sit on the left edge. Tap them to fire all three at once. A beam lights a target on the edge when it passes exactly the lenses drawn outside that target, and it scores its turns plus one, squared, and half as much again for each lens. Light two targets in one shot and the shot counts double; light three and it counts four times over. Every mirror a beam turned at is spent, and so is every lens a lighting beam passed, and lit targets ask for new lenses.
deflectors.how_to_keyboard: Arrows or WASD move the cursor, space or enter puts the next piece under it, R turns the next piece, X bins it, F fires.
deflectors.lines_note: Each emitter's beam is drawn as the grid stands now: a solid line into the target it would light, a thin broken one to wherever else it would leave.
deflectors.recipe_note: Each target wears its recipe outside it: none, one or two small lenses. A glass turns solid once the beam reaching that target passes a lens of its kind. A lens on the way that the recipe does not ask for is ringed in danger: it spoils the beam.
deflectors.shot_note: There is no one right shot. Fire small and often, or build towards a shot that lights two or three targets at once and pays double or four times over. The pieces are few, so each one should earn its place; the clock is short, so don't dwell.
deflectors.spend_note: A shot clears every mirror its beams turned at and every lens a lighting beam passed, so each shot opens room for the next build.
deflectors.hint_note: Practice rounds pulse a cell where the next piece would make the shot worth more when you pause.
deflectors.legend_emitter: Emitter: tap any of them to fire them all. An amber ring says the shot lights something; dim, they are recharging.
deflectors.legend_target: Target. A beam out through it lights it, through exactly the lenses outside it. A ring in a beam's colour says that beam lights it now.
deflectors.legend_mirror: Mirror. A beam turns at every mirror it meets.
deflectors.legend_recipe: A lens. A beam runs straight through it. The small glasses outside a target are the lenses a beam must pass to light it, and no others.
deflectors.legend_queue: The queue: the next piece in its slot, the two after it to plan with. Tap the next piece to turn a mirror. The count beside it is how many pieces the round has left.
deflectors.legend_bin: The bin: tap it to throw the next piece away. It still counts as one of the round's pieces.
deflectors.legend_lit: A solid line, beaded with the emitter's sign: the beam lights a target.
deflectors.legend_miss: A thin broken line: the beam leaves without lighting anything.
